infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RushPoint uses your location to guide you to mission stations.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: RushPoint tracks your location in the background to update your team's position.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RushPoint uses your camera to scan QR codes and capture mission photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RushPoint saves mission photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RushPoint may use your microphone for audio recording during missions.
